newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal supreme court frees ETA suspect.
newsitem.headline: Portugal supreme court frees ETA suspect.

text.p: Portugal's Supreme Court ordered the release on Wednesday of a suspected ETA Basque separatist after rejecting his extradition to Spain, the Portuguese news agency Lusa said.
Jose Luis Telletxea Maya won his appeal after a Lisbon court last month approved a request by Madrid for his extradition on suspicion of collaborating with the armed group, the agency said.

Telletxea Maya, 35, was detained at Lisbon airport in March 1996 for attempting to travel to Venezuela using false papers. Last September he was sentenced to seven months in jail for using false documents.
Court spokesmen were not immediately available.
